scope: All external IDs reviewed; deferred profiles are not completed maintained-owner qualification. Existing scoped owner evidence remains valid at its original scope.

records.title: AAC Program Config Element normalization
records.reason: Qualify the narrow AAC-LC PCE normalizer; compressed packets and full host/browser output remain exact.

records.title: Same-size selected-track fMP4 projection
records.reason: Current selected-video projection plays, but has zero audio output. It is not a full A/V replacement; keep explicit video-only export/selection work separate.

records.title: Do not widen AVC length prefixes without a demonstrated need
records.reason: The maintained remuxer already plays the two-byte AVC length profile. Do not add a blanket prefix-widening pass.

records.title: Strengthen six-channel native FLAC to whole-buffer 24-bit exactness
records.reason: Retain the existing six-channel FLAC study. This new 24-bit subgroup still needs real maintained adaptation, layout and long-duration workload qualification; one browser whole-buffer proof is not that gate.

records.title: Publish decompressed packets only after complete validation
records.reason: Prioritize a later aggregate decompression/source-publication hardening test. Current workers are not the imported simulated DecompressionStream sink; no new total-memory guarantee established.

records.title: Source-defined compatibility islands, without claiming handoff
records.reason: Keep the existing no-opportunity stop: the previously proposed troublesome codec is already accepted. No measured reason for a new native/software handoff here.

records.title: Let a native sink expose minimal repair sets, but not define validity
records.reason: Do not add generic repair search from selected-track removal. The accepted subset deliberately excludes audio; sink acceptance is not source validity.

records.title: Canonicalize an exactly representable explicit AAC sample rate
records.reason: Qualify exact-table explicit AAC sample-rate normalization; non-table rates and unsupported extensions remain rejected.

records.title: Make existing fragments relocatable by repairing their address metadata
records.reason: The maintained remuxer already repairs relative output addressing for this absolute-addressed source; all packets and full decoded output match.

records.title: Synthesize missing decode-time headers from proven continuity
records.reason: The maintained demux/mux owner already accepts the authored missing-tfdt continuity profile; all packets and decoded output match.

records.title: Require a complete set of repairs before deciding a route is impossible
records.reason: The isolated AAC change plus existing remux normalization admits the compound input; exact output matches the canonical presentation. No second generic search engine needed.

records.title: A validated packet still needs a current source owner before publication
records.reason: Keep source-generation publication checks. A real decompression sink/aggregate-budget cancellation stress test remains a separate hardening follow-up; simulated stale-byte counters do not close it.

records.title: A route needs track-output and timing witnesses, not only video and EOF
records.reason: Use track-output witnesses: the video-only D02 presentation has 13 frames and zero RMS, while the qualified A/V/audio routes have nonzero output and independent complete decode checks.

records.title: Jointly declare selected tracks before beginning native playback
records.reason: The maintained default route plays AVC+Vorbis directly with audio. Forced remux is not the cheapest working route and is correctly excluded; no extra mixed-lane owner justified for this fixture.

records.title: A remux must retain both gain and end trimming
records.reason: Current remux output retains exact host PCM and packet payloads for Ogg/WebM/MP4 gain fixtures. Keep the reference-relative tail scope; no universal MSE tail or physical-output claim.

records.title: A true simple FLAC carrier: feasible, not automatically cheaper
records.reason: Retain the stopped unconditional verbatim-FLAC adoption. This screen does not beat the maintained encoder on complete cost.

records.title: Keep video ownership stable through an audio codec change
records.reason: Defer codec-change handoff until exact seam PCM, source cancellation and a stable video owner are implemented. Coarse graph timing is not gapless output.

records.title: A decoding success is not an integrity verdict
records.reason: Retain trusted-integrity separation. Decoding success is not a CRC/MD5/authentication check; the imported bounded integrity controls do not create a new playback optimization.

records.title: Match the numerical contract without expanding the samples
records.reason: Keep the existing restricted FLAC numerical-conversion study; new browser profile is supplemental, not permission to rewrite arbitrary FLAC frames.

records.title: Eliminate disagreement in color interpretation, not coded pictures
records.reason: Known color semantics should propagate; unknown/conflicting authority must not be guessed. R008's full-route fidelity stop remains.

records.title: Source-bound reconstruction of abbreviated JPEG frames
records.reason: Defer timed abbreviated-JPEG ownership until a real source/configuration/epoch consumer is defined; native image decoding alone does not implement MJPEG playback.

records.title: Translate known static orientation into the browser's presentation metadata
records.reason: Static orientation is a restricted metadata bridge. Existing geometry propagation is exercised by D73; dynamic orientation and subtitle/input coordinates remain separate.

records.title: Select independent FLAC channels without decoding their samples
records.reason: Keep explicit independent-channel selection separate from surround preservation/downmixing; retained original cost/guard study is not widened to arbitrary residual/LPC syntax.

records.title: Give RLE subtitle bitmaps to a native PNG decoder without a raster intermediate
records.reason: Preserve the existing bitmap renderer cost stop. A PNG carrier component needs an actual maintained palette/object owner and full compositing comparison before adoption.

records.title: Cold APNG seeks using native PNG subframe views and disposal-aware plans
records.reason: Do not reopen APNG scheduling from component byte/pixel counts alone; compare against the existing retained-checkpoint owner under equal memory.

records.title: Explicit mono duplication and silent slots through Opus mapping
records.reason: Do not promote the mapped Opus profile while the independent default-decoder discrepancy and exact MSE tail remain unresolved.

records.title: Configuration changes without an automatic player rebuild
records.reason: Retain the observed configuration-transition witness failure; a repeated positive does not erase it. Maintained transition lifecycle and every-picture timing are still required.

records.title: Reset parsing and reject stale completions before retry
records.reason: Existing parser-abort study stays inconclusive on cost. The new simulated generation guard is useful guidance, not executed maintained worker cancellation.

records.title: Metadata-only cropping: valid coded output, wrong browser presentation
records.reason: Stop the imported exact metadata-crop profile: requested browser rectangle fails. Do not weaken geometry or substitute host decode for browser presentation.

records.title: Trimming presentation must not delete decode prerequisites
records.reason: Stop naive append-window clipping that removes prerequisites. An exact public excerpt owner with start/end suppression is still absent.

records.title: Change packet grouping after startup rather than imposing one latency policy
records.reason: Retain the prior Opus grouping/delivery study. A dynamic grouping policy needs a real transport/latency workload, not default adoption from equal decoded samples.

records.title: Rewrap G.711 telephony audio rather than decoding it in application code
records.reason: Qualify bounded G.711 AU-to-WAVE admission with both laws, all-code controls, exact host/browser reference PCM and maintained lifecycle/cost.

records.title: Can finite MP4 edit metadata express exact audio excerpts?
records.reason: Stop the tested exact whole-file edit-list audio representation; plausible duration/EOF and unchanged compressed payloads do not repair sample-boundary mismatch.

records.title: Recover original JPEG bytes from JPEG-origin JPEG XL, then use browser JPEG decoding
records.reason: Defer JPEG-XL reconstruction bridge until its reconstruction-only API exists in the supported Wasm runtime and total browser cost is measured.

records.title: Preserve exact edits by moving selection to the native audio scheduler
records.reason: Promising new bounded audio-edit/preview capability. Current preview API returns images and has no sample-window audio scheduler; new owner/lifecycle work remains pending.

records.title: Author a source-indexed edited MP4, then leave playback to the browser
records.reason: Defer browser-side edited-MP4 authoring and authority-aware remote range views until an actual edit/export consumer is defined; host construction is not that integration.

records.title: Refer to repeated coded pictures twice without storing them twice
records.reason: No video decode saving follows from reusing mdat addresses. Reopen only for explicit finite export/storage or measured range-transfer benefit.

records.title: Admit a useful seek GOP without waiting for earlier GOPs
records.reason: Current player already seeks through its source/remux owner. A new out-of-order admission planner needs a real verified-source scheduling workload and cross-track/cancel proof.

records.title: Reuse AVIF coded images as timed AV1 samples, with a presentation gate
records.reason: Defer the restricted RGB AVIF-to-video operation until a timed-image consumer exists; preserve the YUV presentation mismatch and native-image baseline.

records.title: Select whole Opus elementary streams rather than reconstructing every channel
records.reason: Keep exact requested Opus stream selection separate from downmixing; existing six-channel output already works and MSE tail remains unqualified for the new subgroup.

records.title: Restore stripped headers after unlacing, not once per block
records.reason: The maintained remuxer already restores stripped headers per unlaced packet. Xiph, EBML and tail samples retain exact packet and host PCM output.

records.title: Chained audio needs independent configuration, trimming, and decoder state
records.reason: Current forced remux rejects chained Opus as discontinuous. A per-link native owner with independent configuration, trimming and global seek/cancel remains pending.

records.title: Bounded native resampling needs more than a nominal rate ratio
records.reason: Keep successful integer-rate resampling narrow and fractional-rate negatives intact; no new resampler without a consumer already requiring conversion.

records.title: Try an unchanged native destination before projecting sample descriptions
records.reason: Unchanged-source destination selection is preferable for the accepted multi-description profile. No new generic description projector is justified without a maintained-route failure.

records.title: A recovery point is not necessarily a native cold-start point
records.reason: Stop the imported native cold-recovery profile: empty MSE coverage fails before output, despite host recoverability.

records.title: Treat codec/container color conflicts as an authority problem
records.reason: Treat color conflict as source-authority policy. No automatic BT.709 repair or cross-endpoint exact-color claim.

records.title: Bounded Vorbis views across short/long blocks
records.reason: Defer bounded Vorbis previews until there is an explicit sample-window consumer and a complete indexing/setup/retention comparison; preserve persistent-decoder baseline.

records.title: Byte availability is not the complete MP3 output state
records.reason: Stop strict browser MP3 cold-window exactness; reservoir bytes and host proofs do not reproduce the requested browser numerical state.

records.title: Crop the native presentation, not the encoded image
records.reason: Display-only crop is a possible product feature, not less decoding. Native controls, subtitles, high-DPI and source geometry need qualification before adoption.

records.title: Reduce an epoch while timestamps are still integers
records.reason: Use only a regression at a demonstrated integer-to-browser-time boundary. Existing rollover normalization remains; do not add a second unconditional post-demux normalizer.

records.title: Express a requested crossfade in the browser audio graph
records.reason: New audio-edit crossfade capability is deferred with the decoded-audio scheduler; an ordinary native graph is the correct future baseline.

records.title: Preserve explicit silent time with constant FLAC frames
records.reason: Do not invent held silence for transport loss. An upfront trusted silent-interval source/export consumer is required; late repair failure remains.

records.title: A sub-millisecond eviction error can discard a full extra GOP
records.reason: Actual maintained pump plus real MSE preserves the intended last GOP; the 0.1-ms late-cut negative removes it. Regression-only, already implemented.

records.title: Project source subtitles onto an edited native timeline
records.reason: Edited plain-text cue projection needs an edited-timeline consumer. Existing native text ownership remains; richer ASS styling is not silently converted.

records.title: Render bounded finite-filter requests with stable native channel state
records.reason: Promising bounded FIR audio previews require a new audio-preview owner. Preserve explicit channel count, normalize=false, halo and tail requirements; current Native filters do not implement this.

records.title: Preserve an explicit cadence with coded picture recalls
records.reason: For simple picture holds, use truthful durations rather than recall instructions. Reopen coded recall only for fixed-cadence requirements or demonstrated operational value.

records.title: Sparse audio can be scheduled without expanding its held spans
records.reason: Sparse/held WAVE needs an explicit native scheduling owner and authoritative held-sample semantics. Current remux fails; global seek/cancel/A-V behavior remains pending.

records.title: Give a native IIR filter only enough history for a declared error budget
records.reason: A bounded-error IIR preview is opt-in, not transparent exact playback. Defer the browser arithmetic guarantee and full-cost comparison until a preview consumer exists.

records.title: Native JPEG decoding for restricted TIFF pages and regions
records.reason: TIFF pages/regions are a new image capability; current getFrame API does not define page/strip/orientation ownership. Keep wrong-table/strip controls and require a real consumer.

records.title: Destination-specific recovery of mislabeled random-access samples
records.reason: Re-executed source-bound IDR-flag repair exactly reconstructs the authored original, rejects 76 dependent samples and restores ten maintained seeks/EOF. No arbitrary-source sync relabeling.

records.title: One bounded copy can make native audio looping correct
records.reason: Promising same-rate isolated-cycle audio-preview operation; no maintained decoded-buffer loop owner exists. Fractional-rate exactness remains failed, not relaxed.

records.title: Retain PGS object data, not stale rendered subtitles
records.reason: Reuse existing PGS object/palette ownership before adding a parser. Epoch/content-keyed invalidation and arbitrary palette compositing are not qualified by the imported neutral-palette component.

records.title: Native clipping of lossless audio at individual sample boundaries
records.reason: Lossless sample clipping is a new explicit operation, not general queue correctness. Preserve the source-derived length/content witnesses and require a maintained excerpt owner.

records.title: Join independent FLAC selections without creating a new encoded bridge
records.reason: Do not reverse the prior AAC queue stop using independent FLAC clips. New live additions still need seek/cancel, jitter, memory and physical continuity qualification.

records.title: Select an Ogg logical stream by retaining its original pages
records.reason: Qualify finite source-bound Ogg FLAC page projection after the maintained selected-track remux fails seek; both streams retain exact pages/PCM and pass full finite lifecycle/cost.

records.title: Separate source-local track numbering from playback-lane numbering
records.reason: Source-local track IDs and stable lane identity are separate. Existing generation ownership must be tested before omitting per-source initialization in a real queue.

records.title: Native image decoding with a source-derived animation seek plan
records.reason: Defer new WebP preview adapter until binary-alpha admission is trustworthy and it beats the maintained persistent/checkpoint baseline. Fractional-alpha failure remains.

records.title: Preserve PCM values while changing only the incompatible representation
records.reason: Qualify bounded CAF PCM representation conversion: five endian/precision profiles exact; finite maintained playback/seek/EOF and representative cost pass.

records.title: Translate the packet table, not just the packet bytes
records.reason: Qualify declared-table CAF Opus-to-Ogg projection. Current remux keeps packet bytes but returns 143 extra frames; the candidate returns exact declared PCM and passes lifecycle/cost.

records.title: Give native text the syllable timeline rather than repainting it in JavaScript
records.reason: Native-style syllable timing is a separate explicitly permitted subtitle feature. Do not convert full ASS styling or reopen the prior cost miss without a maintained text-owner comparison.

records.title: Compressed-only reverse views of independently decodable video
records.reason: Defer reverse/permutation authoring until an existing all-independent-source consumer needs it. Predictive video is rejected; preprocessing it to all-IDR is not free.

records.title: Preserve sparse-video durations instead of guessing a constant frame rate
records.reason: Current route retains checked held-frame pictures and final coverage, but repeated terminal held-frame seek/play fails lifecycle. Stop promotion; the irrelevant WebM muxer patch is rejected.

records.title: Resolve geometry at the boundary that actually presents it
records.reason: Maintained coherent SAR/rotation geometry passes. This does not resolve metadata authority conflicts or overturn R008's prior full-route pixel-fidelity stop.
